## Bug Scenario and Root Cause

### Bug Description
The issue described in the bug report and depicted in the image is that after performing a search and selecting all results in the `CascaderSelect` component, the search results are not automatically cleared. Users remain on the search results page without knowing how to return to the full list view unless they click outside the dropdown and reopen it.

### Root Cause
The root cause is that the current implementation lacks a mechanism to clear the search results when all items are selected. There is also no button in the component to manually clear the search results.

## Analyzing the Bug Code Snippets
The bug code snippets are from the `components/cascader-select/cascader-select.tsx` file, which contains the `handleChange` method responsible for managing the value change logic. In this method, there is an opportunity to add logic to clear the search value when all items are selected.

## Proposed Solution
- Modify the `handleChange` method to check if all items are selected and reset the `searchValue` state.
- Add a button to clear the current search field.
